q1_issues.issue: The of-complement of the adjective 'full' is rendered as a spatial containment claim (LocatedIn group-in-fountain) that no locative word in the sentence licenses.
'full' is emitted as a bare one-place property of the fountain, so nothing ties the fullness to the women and the of-phrase's contribution is unrecoverable from the two atoms taken together.

q2_gaps: adjective + of-complement ('full of X', 'fond of X', 'aware of X') — the of-phrase section covers only genitive, partitive 'of the', measure and 'about' of-phrases, never an of-phrase governed by a predicate adjective
notes: LocatedIn is a licensed head; the defect is its use for a construction the instruction set never routes to it. The bare-plural 'women' as a group witness rather than the bare class symbol is defensible either way.
